items.information:
This is the State Championship for Utah. To be recognized as the Utah Champion, please register your state of residence on [CubingUSA!](https://cubingusa.org/) Anyone may register for the competition but only Utah Residents are eligible for the Utah Champion title.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the [Registration and Waistlist Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahChampionship2023#30564-registration-and-waitlist-info) tab. 

Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

venue.name: Hagaskolan
venue.details: Matsalen. Enter the building coming straight from the "Bäckvägen" intersection.

items.information:
Välkomna till Norrlandsmästerskapet 2025! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Norrland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Norrlandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2025#60533-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)".

-----

Welcome to Norrlandsmästerskapet 2025!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Norrland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2025#60533-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)".

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**.

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Want to know when the next competition is? Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: 282.098.828-80 (CPF)

Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade.

Payment with PIX method: 282.098.828-80 (CPF)

Send the payment proof to E-mail: helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br
**Send the proof with the competitor's name.**

Members of the Aclimação Aquatic Club will have a 50% discount on registration and will have to inform in the comments field that they are members and prove it on the day of the competition.
